knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Flight Delay Data Preprocessing

```{r load-data}
# Load data
INPUT_FILE <- "data/T_ONTIME_REPORTING.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE <- "data/flight_january_2025.csv"

df <- read.csv(
  INPUT_FILE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Original data\n")
cat("Dataset shape:", nrow(df), "rows,", ncol(df), "columns\n")

cat("\nColumns:\n")
print(names(df))

cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
print(head(df, 5))

cat("\nData types:\n")
str(df)
```

```{r remove-duplicates}
# Remove duplicate rows
duplicate_count <- sum(duplicated(df))

df <- df[!duplicated(df), ]

cat("\nDuplicate rows removed:", duplicate_count, "\n")
cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

```{r convert-data}
# Convert flight date
df$FL_DATE <- as.Date(
  df$FL_DATE,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p"
)

# Convert numerical columns
numeric_columns <- c(
  "CRS_DEP_TIME",
  "CRS_ARR_TIME",
  "ARR_DELAY",
  "CANCELLED",
  "DIVERTED",
  "CRS_ELAPSED_TIME",
  "DISTANCE"
)

for (column in numeric_columns) {
  df[[column]] <- as.numeric(df[[column]])
}

# Check date range
cat("\nDate range\n")
cat("Earliest date:", min(df$FL_DATE, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Latest date:", max(df$FL_DATE, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Unique dates:", length(unique(df$FL_DATE)), "\n")
```

```{r filter-january}
# Filter January 2025
df <- df[
  df$FL_DATE >= as.Date("2025-01-01") &
    df$FL_DATE < as.Date("2025-02-01"),
]

cat("\nRows after January 2025 filter:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

```{r filter-airports}
# Filter selected airports
airports <- c("ATL", "ORD", "DFW", "DEN", "JFK")

df <- df[df$ORIGIN %in% airports, ]

cat("\nAirport filter\n")
cat("Selected airports:", paste(airports, collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("\nFlights by origin airport:\n")
print(table(df$ORIGIN))

cat("\nRows after airport filtering:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

```{r remove-cancelled-diverted}
# Remove cancelled and diverted flights
cancelled_count <- sum(df$CANCELLED == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
diverted_count <- sum(df$DIVERTED == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

df <- df[
  df$CANCELLED == 0 &
    df$DIVERTED == 0,
]

cat("\nCancelled and diverted flights\n")
cat("Cancelled flights:", cancelled_count, "\n")
cat("Diverted flights:", diverted_count, "\n")
cat("Rows after removing cancelled/diverted:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

```{r remove-missing}
# Remove missing arrival delay
missing_arr_delay <- sum(is.na(df$ARR_DELAY))

df <- df[!is.na(df$ARR_DELAY), ]

cat("\nMissing ARR_DELAY removed:", missing_arr_delay, "\n")
cat("Rows after removing missing target:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

```{r create-target}
# Create target variables
df$major_delay_30 <- as.integer(df$ARR_DELAY >= 30)
df$major_delay_60 <- as.integer(df$ARR_DELAY >= 60)

# Show target distribution
show_target_distribution <- function(target_column) {

  counts <- table(
    factor(df[[target_column]], levels = c(0, 1))
  )

  percentages <- prop.table(counts) * 100

  result <- data.frame(
    Count = as.integer(counts),
    Percentage = as.numeric(percentages)
  )

  rownames(result) <- c("0", "1")

  cat("\nTarget:", target_column, "\n")
  print(result)
}

cat("\nTarget distribution\n")

show_target_distribution("major_delay_30")
show_target_distribution("major_delay_60")
```

```{r date-features}
# Create date features
df$month <- as.integer(format(df$FL_DATE, "%m"))

df$day_of_week <- as.integer(
  format(df$FL_DATE, "%u")
) - 1
```

```{r scheduled-time}
# Convert HHMM to minutes
hhmm_to_minutes <- function(value) {

  if (is.na(value)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  value <- as.integer(value)

  hour <- value %/% 100
  minute <- value %% 100

  if (hour > 23 || minute > 59) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  return(hour * 60 + minute)
}

# Create scheduled time features
df$scheduled_departure_minutes <- sapply(
  df$CRS_DEP_TIME,
  hhmm_to_minutes
)

df$scheduled_arrival_minutes <- sapply(
  df$CRS_ARR_TIME,
  hhmm_to_minutes
)

df$scheduled_departure_hour <- floor(
  df$scheduled_departure_minutes / 60
)

df$scheduled_arrival_hour <- floor(
  df$scheduled_arrival_minutes / 60
)

# Check scheduled time
cat("\nScheduled time features\n")

print(
  head(
    df[
      ,
      c(
        "CRS_DEP_TIME",
        "CRS_ARR_TIME",
        "scheduled_departure_minutes",
        "scheduled_arrival_minutes",
        "scheduled_departure_hour",
        "scheduled_arrival_hour"
      )
    ],
    5
  )
)

# Check invalid scheduled times
invalid_departure_count <- sum(
  is.na(df$scheduled_departure_minutes)
)

invalid_arrival_count <- sum(
  is.na(df$scheduled_arrival_minutes)
)

cat("\nInvalid scheduled times\n")
cat("Invalid departure:", invalid_departure_count, "\n")
cat("Invalid arrival:", invalid_arrival_count, "\n")
```

```{r missing-values}
# Check missing values
cat("\nMissing values\n")

print(colSums(is.na(df)))

cat(
  "Total missing values:",
  sum(is.na(df)),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r final-dataset}
# Final dataset
cat("\nFinal dataset\n")
cat("Dataset shape:", nrow(df), "rows,", ncol(df), "columns\n")

cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
print(head(df, 5))

cat("\nFlights by origin airport:\n")
print(table(df$ORIGIN))

# Summary statistics
cat("\nArrival delay statistics\n")
print(summary(df$ARR_DELAY))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 30 minutes\n")
print(table(df$major_delay_30))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 60 minutes\n")
print(table(df$major_delay_60))
```

```{r save-data}
# Save processed data
write.csv(
  df,
  OUTPUT_FILE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nPreprocessing completed\n")
cat("Output file:", OUTPUT_FILE, "\n")
cat("Final rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Final columns:", ncol(df), "\n")
cat("File saved successfully.\n")
```
